public_rationale: The statement leaves “many problems” unspecified and gives no standard for “beginning to fix” them, so the whole claim cannot be scored reliably [wyea-the-anti-economy-6cfef8-o1]. OpenAI’s March 2023 GPT-4 report acknowledged factual and reasoning errors [e1]. A study published November 28, 2023 found that content-generating tasks were the most energy-intensive tasks in its tested sample [e2]. In a coding experiment completed June 20, 2022, participants with Copilot completed a JavaScript HTTP-server task 55.8% faster than controls [e3]. These findings address particular models and tasks, without settling the claim about unspecified promoted problems [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The energy comparison establishes relative energy use in the tested sample, not monetary operating costs or company losses [e2].
The coding result does not establish benefits on other tasks or rule out failure on other problems [e3].
The evidence does not pair a defined set of promotional promises with evaluations using a stated standard for useful progress [e1, e2, e3].
